name: Street Construction Permits - Cranes
description:
This dataset contains 5,000 records of street construction permits that involve cranes. Each row represents a single crane associated with a permit and includes the permit number, a short description of the crane type (such as Main - Mobile, Main, Assist, or Crawler), the crane's serial number, and timestamps for when the record was created and last modified. All five columns are complete with no missing values, and the records span permit activity from roughly 2015 through 2018.

The data can be used to study how often different crane types are deployed for street construction, track permit and equipment activity over time, and cross-check crane serial numbers against permit records. It may also support urban planning and infrastructure management work, such as identifying periods of heavy construction activity or understanding the mix of equipment used on public streets.
